name: Chains of Darkness pulls, damages and taunts every enemy in range (#1216)
contract: Chains of Darkness 680521 (installed Spell.dbc) is a 180000 ms cooldown spell whose only effect is TRIGGER_SPELL 680522 on TARGET_SRC_CASTER + TARGET_UNIT_SRC_AREA_ENEMY (radius index 9 = 20 yd, SpellRadius.dbc). Helper 680522 has effect 0 PULL_TOWARDS (misc 250, jump onto the caster), effect 1 SCHOOL_DAMAGE base 48 die 2 +1.0 per level over level 25 (level 60: 83 + 1..2 = 84-85, plus the authored 15% AP / 55% SP coefficients added by the module base-value hook) and effect 2 SPELL_AURA_MOD_TAUNT with duration index 27 = 3000 ms. The tooltip reads 'Pull all nearby enemies to you, dealing ... Shadow damage and taunting them for 3 sec'. Three level-60 dummies stand 12, 15 and 18 yd away (all inside the 20 yd radius); each must be pulled to the hunter, take positive damage, carry the taunt with at most 3 s left, and the helper must have been cast once per enemy. The damage total is only bounded below (60, under the 84 base) because attack power is not a value this scenario may assume and a critical hit or the AP term only raise it; the value query on the helper's damage effect is bounded 84-400 for the same reason.
